name: auth-failure
description: Workspace ONE UEM requires the aw-tenant-code header AND Basic auth together; supplying only one answers 403 and yields nothing. Here page 0 succeeds and page 1 answers 403, which is what a mid-run credential or role change looks like. The run must keep the devices it already reported, emit the API-key-specific diagnostic rather than the password one, and stop cleanly instead of retrying forever or aborting. check_determinism is off because the id is scoped by the tenant host, which under the fixture server carries an ephemeral port.

json.message: aw-tenant-code header missing or the account holds no API role

log_contains: workspace-one-uem: failed to fetch devices on page 1
workspace-one-uem: check the API key and that the account holds a read-only API role
